name: speech-command-accuracy
provenance: Hand-authored text, released CC0. There are no recordings of real people here and no audio files at all: each utterance is a reference transcript plus the plausible transcript a recogniser might return for it under one condition. That makes the corpus redistributable and the runner offline, and it also means this is not a recording of any actual microphone or model.

conditions.clean: close microphone, quiet room, clear speech
conditions.accented: clear audio, non-native or regional accent: substitutions and merged words
conditions.noisy: fan, street or crowded room: dropped words and filler insertions
conditions.numbers-names: digits, amounts and people's names, where one wrong digit or letter changes the command
